behavioral_effects: fix-issue now opens the gov-change envelope, requires the regression test before the fix, and routes unknown causes to engineering:debug
review now verifies the proxy-hop contract (handler, client, caller) and frontend conventions instead of backend-only checks, and verifies against sources rather than briefings
add-endpoint slimmed to the dependency-ordered scaffold; net -13 lines of restated rules that auto-load anyway
compatibility_impact: None - command names unchanged; slash-command routing stable
follow_up: S5 flips skills-check to strict and adds the CI step
limitations: Commands are guidance, not enforcement; the Stop hook remains the backstop when a direct invocation skips the envelope
reason: fix-issue never opens an envelope or writes a regression test first, review checks only the backend and skips the proxy hop that architecture policy declares part of every REST chain, and add-endpoint restates rules that auto-load - commands that predate the constitution teach agents to ignore it
rollback: git revert of the single commit; no generated files moved
security_impact: None - command text and provenance records only
summary: Bring the three commands into the governance era
